# External platforms

Facts about third-party platforms, written by hand from the platforms' own documentation: what their APIs offer, authentication, limits and quotas, terms of use, and known quirks.
Each fact links to its source and states when it was last checked, because platforms change.
Integration designs (in architecture) build on these facts.

> Not written yet. Each platform gets a doc at a path matching the component that integrates it.
